title: Stocks Erase Post-Midterm Elections Rally, Dragged Down by Tech

title: Tech Billionaires Face Tricky Political Waters After Democratic Midterm Sweep
partialText: Many donated money to President Trump’s favored causes and became his allies. Now that political alignment may be a liability.

title: The Machine, and the Messaging, That Won Texas for Democrats
partialText: Years of organizing met a moment of voter discontent, as James Talarico and Gina Hinojosa offered Texans a vision of economic relief and political change.

title: How Democrats Won Across the South
partialText: They won Senate races in North Carolina, South Carolina and Georgia, with a Mississippi race still too close to call. Their wins lifted down-ballot candidates too.

title: How Colom Changed a Long Shot in Mississippi Into a Race Too Close to Call

title: Across the South, Black Voters Help Propel Democratic Wins
partialText: Democrats in the South used anger over redistricting, cuts to key federal programs and attacks on Black history to help galvanize a crucial bloc of voters to the polls.

title: Newsom Commutes the Sentences of California’s 548 Death Row Inmates
partialText: Gov. Gavin Newsom, who is expected to run for president, called capital punishment morally objectionable. Though California hasn’t executed anyone for 20 years, that represents about a quarter of death sentences nationwide.

title: DOJ Steps Up Leak Investigation on Supreme Court Decision Overturning Roe v. Wade
partialText: Investigators, using subpoenas and other law enforcement powers, are accelerating an inquiry that takes the Trump administration into the inner workings of the court.

title: Justice Alito Will Not Retire From Supreme Court Immediately, Despite Election Outcome

title: Up in the Clouds With the Pope, It’s Still Commercial

title: Harmeet Dhillon, Leader of Justice Department’s Civil Rights Unit, Resigns

title: How Did Flávio Bolsonaro Flee Brazil? ‘I’ll Take That to the Grave,’ He Says
partialText: From Miami, Flávio Bolsonaro is making unfounded claims of a stolen election and plotting to sway his nation’s politics from afar, even though his party is not challenging the results.

title: Bolsonaro’s Escape From Brazil Was Aided by Milei Adviser at Argentine Airport
partialText: A top adviser to President Javier Milei of Argentina met Flávio Bolsonaro, the defeated Brazilian presidential candidate, at an Argentine airport, three people involved in the operation said.

title: He Felt Stuck in New York. So He Started Walking to California.

title: How Melania Trump Became a Dark-Horse Diplomat on Ukraine
